description: Create a new Incident Alert in OneUptime. Returns the created Incident Alert object with its ID. Use this to add new Incident Alerts to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

alertId.description: ID of the Alert that is linked to the incident.

incidentId.description: ID of the Incident this alert is linked to.

projectId.description: ID of your OneUptime Project in which this object belongs.

name: create_incident_alert
title: Create Incident Alert
